articleTitle: Development of numerical integration algorithms for modeling by method of boundary elements
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Numerical algorithm for integration in method of boundary elements is proposed. The method is applied for different basis functions of different orders and results are discussed.

articleTitle: Accuracy enhancement of distributed irregularities estimation in optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The model operation results of the Brillouin Backscattering effect on the distributed irregularities in fiber-optical communication links are given in this paper.

articleTitle: Method of an assessment of reliability of high-precision measurements
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Authors offer a new principle of comparison of characteristics and calibration of optical interferential measuring systems with various lengths of waves of laser radiation. Results of measurements of exemplary and certified measuring systems are represented in the form of the decision of system of comparisons which is displayed on a complex phase plane. The offered approach allows receiving with split-hair accuracy an estimation of casual and regular errors of measurements without use of specially prepared standards.

articleTitle: Current generator for testing power semiconductor devices in high conduction state
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper describes current generator for testing power semiconductor devices in high conduction state. Modeling of generator operation is performed by Multisim software. Advantages of the generator are discussed.

articleTitle: Sliding mode control of vector controlled induction motor drive
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the speed control of the induction motor drive. The control strategy is based on the sliding mode technique. The decoupling between motor speed and rotor flux amplitude has been achieved using the field orientation principle. The control law has been designed such that the uncertainty due to motor parameters variation can be eliminated. Also, the chattering problem associated with classical sliding mode control has been solved by suggesting an adaptive load torque disturbance estimator. Digital simulations have been carried out in order to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme. The induction motor with the proposed controller has been tested through mismatched rotor resistance, and load torque disturbance. The results prove that the induction motor with the proposed controller has good robustness in face of uncertainties including load disturbance. Moreover, accurate tracking performance has been achieved.

articleTitle: Estimation of validity of optical measurements
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New principle for comparing characteristics and for calibrating optical interference measurement systems with different laser wave lengths is proposed. Results of measurements obtained with both the reference and the tested measuring systems are represented in the form of solution of comparison system that is mapped on the complex phase plane. The proposed approach allows obtaining estimates for random and systematic errors with high accuracy without using specific references.

articleTitle: DVB-T2 advantages and its construction features on the base of DVB-T equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article reveals advantages of the Digital Video Broadcasting standard DVB-T2 in comparison with DVB-T. It shows the opportunity of upgrading equipment by means of change the program code.

articleTitle: Vector controlled induction motor drive based on model predictive control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the application of the model predictive control (MPC) technique for controlling the speed of the induction motor drive. Vector control principle has been used for decoupling between motor speed and rotor flux. A simple model of induction motor is employed in the MPC structure so as to minimize the computational load. The MPC controller design is taken into account the effect of uncertainty due to motor parameters variation and load disturbance could be reduced. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme has been successfully verified through simulations. The performance of the system including the MPC controller is compared with the corresponding one using the traditional PI controller. The results proved that the induction motor with the MPC speed controller has superior transient response, and good robustness in face of uncertainties including load disturbance. Moreover, accurate tracking performance has been achieved.

articleTitle: Application of synchronous-hysteresis motors as electrical drivers for tube armature
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Application of different types of electrical motors as drivers for tube armature is considered. Main concern is given to possibility of the motor to close crossection of product supply tube. Advantages of synchronous-hysteresis motors compared to other types are shown.

articleTitle: Silicon wire waveguide crossing with negligible loss and crosstalk
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Current paper introduces efficient silicon wire waveguide crossing by means of vertical coupling of tapered Si wire with upper SU-8 polymer wide strip waveguide through a silica buffer. Numerical 3D simulations by FDTD proves that optimal structure of 70 μm length provided 98% efficiency for through pass and 99.9% efficiency for cross pass as well as negligible back reflection (-50 dB) and cross talk (-70 dB). Proposed waveguide crossing on thin silicon-on-insulator CMOS compatible structures could find multiple applications in photonics.

articleTitle: 3D inversion of data soundings of the field formation on the basis of Born approximation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The opportunities of applying quasi-three-dimensional electromagnetic fields modeling methods for complex three-dimensional models, including both target object and objects in upper layers are discussed. The results of using methods based on Born approximation for inversion of synthetic data are described.

articleTitle: Error of indirect measurements of the distance of possible intercept of unwanted electromagnetic radiation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Estimates for absolute and relative error of distance of possible intercept of unwanted electromagnetic radiation are presented. Results are analyzed and can be used for taking into account in calculations.

articleTitle: Improvement of quasi-Yagi antenna performances by using the monopole driver
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes a new modification of printed Yagi antennas. The presented antenna can significantly reduce a size in comparison with the well-known printed dipole Yagi antennas. There are the rules of quasi-Yagi antenna pattern's formation and impedance matching conditions are considered in this article. After calculating characteristics and sizes of the antenna, the quasi-Yagi antenna was optimized using computer simulation. Optimization of the antenna was carried out on the center frequency of 1.85 GHz. As a result, the printed quasi-Yagi antenna has much smaller dimension and weight characteristics compared to its analogs and can be used in wireless telecommunication systems.

articleTitle: One of the possibilities of the disease diagnosing by the electrical method based on the Su Jok System
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the possibility of the early detection of diseases based on the Su Jok System using the electrical resistance of points of correspondence. Researches have shown that the electrical resistance of the points of correspondence becomes less than the resistance of surrounding points before pathological signs appear which means the possibility of early diagnosis.

articleTitle: Novel multi-splitting widely tunable filter on SOI technology
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper proposes and makes numerical investigation of new tunable optical filter which utilized multiple coupled silicon wire waveguides on SOI structures. Numerical simulation by 2D FDTD proves its general conception and demonstrates that a short 321 μm structure with 32 couplers has spectral resolutions 1.7 nm, loss -1 dB and side-lobes below -26 dB. It provides wavelength tuning (without Vernier principle) within total FSR 36.8 nm at central optical wavelength 1.55 μm by temperature change up to 100 C° in four sets of thermo optic phase shifters. Device of 1 cm size provides 0.05 nm filter linewidth. Filter can be manufactured by CMOS compatible technology and very promising for applications in photonics.

articleTitle: The call-center. Development of algorithm routings of calls
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Process of routing of calls is considered. On the basis of the data of system of monitoring and management of the Call-center calculation of an average timeout of the answer of the operator is executed. The generalized algorithm of routing of calls is developed.

articleTitle: Applying of numerical methods for modeling of nonlinear effects in optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Main nonlinear effects in optical fiber are considered in this paper. Special attention is given to physical aspect of effects and methods of mathematical modeling.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the control system of bidirectional DC-DC converter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The report below concentrates on the construction of the bidirectional DC-DC power converter. There discussed the problems of the power section development, the structure of the control system and the synthesis of DC converter controls. There presented the results of experimental researches of the converter in the frequency-controlled induction motor electric drive system.

articleTitle: Program system for active parametric identification of stochastic dynamical systems APIS
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Program system for active parametric identification of stochastic dynamical systems described by nonlinear discrete and continuous-discrete models in state space is considered. The general case is discussed, when unknown parameters are in state equation, in observation equation, in initial conditions, in covariant matrix of dynamic interference and measurement errors.

articleTitle: Study of capacitance distribution in micro-strip line by finite elements method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Method of capacitance distribution calculation in a cross section of a micro-strip line is studied. The numerical solution of the boundary problem by finite element method was used as well as the calculation using preliminary conformal mapping of the integrated area. The used algorithms allow determining partial capacitance of the any discrete area of the cross section of the strip line on the dielectric surface.

articleTitle: Digital control system oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Design concept of digital control system with real time data acquisition algorithm is considered in this paper. An alternative design approach of data transmission and processing algorithm concerning regulators operation of digital control system for semiconductor power supply device is observed. Comparison of operation results between proposed approach and usually used digital oscilloscope is performed.

articleTitle: Piggyback photoelectric encoder for high-precision angular measurement
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The new kind of piggyback photoelectric encoder (PPE) is proposed. It will allow to increasing the accuracy o f an gula r measuring. The result is achieving due to simultaneously precisely measure the angle of rotation and the shifting of encoder axis in the radial direction.

articleTitle: A novel ends-fed dipole radiator
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel approach to enhance the dipole antenna performances by using so-called an ends-fed dipole radiator is presented. Since the area around the radiating arms is free of any conductors, the proposed radiator is very good candidate to create the high polarization purity of radiation. The simulated results have revealed that such a radiator is able to achieve a high polarization purity with enhanced up to 12 dB front-to-back ratio without decreasing the bandwidth.

articleTitle: Additional treatments for venous ulcers: A way to accelerate the healing of wounds
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes research on the use of the medical system for the healing of venous ulcers and the solutions to the application of variable frequency magnetic field with counter “flow”, which will increase the effectiveness of physical treatments and reduce the healing time of ulcers.

articleTitle: The generalized analysis of parameters measurement of processes in QMS
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: On the basis of the generalized model of measurement the main equations of measurement of processes in QMS are received.

articleTitle: Estimation of signals of airborne electrical exploration of mineral products
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Algorithm of estimation of parameters of signal of airborne electrical exploration of mineral products is considered.

articleTitle: Scaling of input-output data and number of conditionality of a matrix of Grama
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Is considered procedure of scaling of the input and output data for increase of accuracy of estimations in problems of parametrical identification of the objects described by models in the form of space state. Offered procedure allows to eliminate influence of property of small changes of sequence of measurements concerning some constant. Results of calculations of numbers of conditionality of information matrixes Grama received with the help a component of a vector of input and output variables without scaling and by data with preliminary procedure of scaling are resulted.

articleTitle: Application of the hidden Markov models, kNN and SVM for a classification problem modes of power supply system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In work results of use of the hidden markov models (HMM) with initiated these models signs for classification of the signals representing a total current, removed on an entrance of an electric chain are presented. Classification of such signals with use of the k-nearest neighbor classifier (kNN) and the classifier based on a method of support vector machine (SVM) is considered.

articleTitle: Simulation of natural linewidth and line form for semiconductor lasers; Interpretation of experiments
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A new formula for line form inside and outside laser is derived. The natural linewidth is calculated on the basis of the derived formula for the line form. Our simulation of the natural linewidth for Fabry-Perot lasers allows explaining all known to us experimental measurements of semiconductor laser natural linewidth.

articleTitle: Research of various methods of signal pulse-width modulation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Various ways of formation of signals with pulse-width modulation (PWM) are considered. The analysis of an error of the first harmonica and factor of nonlinear distortions of a PWM signal depending on its parameters and from the chosen way of formation is provided

articleTitle: Software and hardware complex for detecting forest fire
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Problem of automated detecting forest fire using web-cameras is considered. Problems, solutions, image data processing are discussed. Architecture of software and hardware complex is proposed as well as principle of its operation.

articleTitle: Synthesis of noble metals nanoparticles in water by laser ablation method for biomedical applications and cosmetology
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Obtained stable colloidal solutions of nanoparticles of silver, gold and platinum with an average size of 3.5 to 15 nm by the method of laser ablation of bulk metal targets in water. For further stabilization of colloids used in macromolecular SAS — polyvinylpyrrolidone and polyethylene glycol. The particle size distribution (TEM), the spectral properties and stability of solutions in time were investigated. The resulting dispersions are used for biomedical research, an additive in cosmetic products, and optical applications. In addition, the analysis of biological toxicity of nanomaterials was carried out.

articleTitle: Segmentation algorithm with several dominant directions
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Investigation of characteristics of texture segmentation algorithm with several dominant directions is presented. The investigation is based on gradient structure tensor for different differentiators.

articleTitle: Synthesis of parametric frequency divider of harmonic oscillations (PFDHO)
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of synthesis of frequency dividers of harmonic oscillation on nonlinear jet elements is proposed. Its essence consists of searching a mode with the maximum output power and/or the maximum power transfer factor and circuit design of the founded optimum mode. The method is illus t rated on the concrete example.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of algorithms for forming group time keepers scales
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper represents results of comparative analysis of algorithms for forming group time keepers scales used in various measurement systems. Estimates for time scales forming accuracy are obtained and are used in the algorithms parameters choice.

articleTitle: An input impedance of double-V dipole radiator with orthogonal halves
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The input impedance frequency responses of the double-V dipole radiator are studied. Both the halves of the radiator are placed in an orthogonal planes with the collinear bisectors lying inside the V-letter. The polynomials approximating the input impedance frequency responses around the resonance are presented.

articleTitle: Setting up position of equivalent radiation center in 3-point matrix imitator
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Method to set up position of equivalent radiation center in 3-point matrix imitator of arbitrary geometry is considered. Analytical equations for apparent radiation center in azimuth and elevation planes are obtained.

articleTitle: New dipole irradiator with end feed
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New approach to improvement of a dipole antenna by using the dipole irradiator with end feed is proposed. Since no conductors are in the central part of the irradiator the radiation is highly polarized. The simulation results show that considered irradiator provides high degree of polarization and up to 12 Db better front-back radiation ratio without decrease of broadbandness.

articleTitle: Effect of various grouping on the power of χ2-type goodness of fit criteria
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Power of criteria χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> Pearson, Japaridze-Nikulin) for various groupings and number of (χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> grouping intervals is considered.

articleTitle: Program system for statistical modeling in the problems of measurement and data processing on the platform 1C: Predpriyatie 8.2
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper considers main features of the system of statistical analysis based on the platform "1C:Predpriyatie 8.2".

articleTitle: Application of S-graphs for modeling systems of metrological procurement and control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Graphical representation of systems of metrological procurement and production control is based on using structure diagram where elements have 2n poles. These elements can be represented as directed graphs. To obtain graphical models one can use S-graph structures based on scattering matrices. The matrices contain all information on the system behavior, satisfy probabilities normalization requirement and causality principle.

articleTitle: Design method for digital recursive filter with linear phase-frequency characteristic
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper considers design method for digital recursive filter with linear phase-frequency characteristic. The method is based on determination of transfer function using pulse response of finite impulse response filter.

articleTitle: Ring divider-adders with nonuniform power division
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Two variations of ring power divider-adders withnonuniform power division are considered: classical and with additional λ/4 length feeder section in input. All necessary equations are obtained. The second variation revealed significant increase in broadbandness and can be recommended for developers.

articleTitle: Simulation of natural linewidth and line form for semiconductor lasers; Interpretation of experiments
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)

Our simulation of the natural linewidth for Fabry-Perotlasers allows explaining all known to us experimental measurements of semiconductor laser natural linewidth.

articleTitle: Classification of moving objects based on energy attributes in seismic guard systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New method for classification of objects in seismic guard systems is proposed. The method is based on using energy attributes of different types of objects. Principle of maximal likelihood is used for classification.

articleTitle: The influence of the configuration of the chink of secondary lead single lens at the optical parameters
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Analyzed the impact of size and shape of the chink of the middle electrode crossed lenses for optical effect and spherical aberration. It is shown that under certain sizes chink can be to obtain high values of optical power and small spherical aberration.

articleTitle: Estimation method for functional dependence of reliability indexes on the operation time in radio electronic systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The summary — Dynamics o f change o f reliability o f radio-electronic means in time essentially depends on climatic factors, an electromagnetic situation and factors of wear and equipment aging. The method, allowing to estimate dynamics of change of reliability through definition of a look and parameters of function of density of distribution of defining parameters of equipment is offered. Method application for search of regularity of change in time of parameter of a stream of refusals of equipment is shown.

articleTitle: Analysis of overheat mechanisms in Ge/Si heterostructures during molecular beam epitaxy
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: During the molecular beam epitaxy of Ge film on the Si substrate the heterostructure's temperature increases comparing to the initials substrate's temperature when the thickness of the film increases. Since the film growth in the conditions of no controlled temperature increase leads to decrease of the film structure quality the temperature of the substrate should be corrected over the time. When the temperature of the heater increases from 1000°C to 1500°C the overheat grows from 35°C to 90°C.

articleTitle: Compression of facsimile information using universal methods
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Dependence of compression coefficient on the type of being coded sequence is considered. Universal method of uniform compression output for unknown information source is discussed. The universal method for uniform compression input for Markovian source is proposed. Asymptotic optimality of the last method is proved.

articleTitle: Designing MW transistor model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of designing MW transistor model are presented. Designing is based on measurement of S parameters for cutoff mode and operating point.

articleTitle: Thermal nonuniformities and mechanism of Brownian motion
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of studying physical mechanism of Brownian motion in liquid are presented. Model explaining this phenomenon on the basis of low scale thermal nonuniformities is proposed.

articleTitle: Thermal inhomogeneities and the mechanism of Brownian motion
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of an investigation of the physical mechanism of Brownian motion in a liquid are presented. A model explaining this phenomenon on the basis of the existence small-scale thermal inhomogeneities is proposed.

articleTitle: Development of design method for MEM generator with charge doubling
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of theoretical and experimental research on operation of microelectromechanical generator with charge doubling are considered. It is shown that diodes' reverse currents should be taken into account. The design method is presented.

articleTitle: The conjugate convective heat transfer in fluid and gas vertical layers
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Influence of finite thermal conductivity of boundaries on flow structure in fluid (with Prandtl number Pr = 16) and gas (with Pr = 0,66) vertical layers with walls, heated to different temperatures, and on local performances of natural convection boundary layers over the range Grashof numbers from 100 < Gr < 106 is explored. The finite element method in Cartesian coordinates solves the equations of thermogravitational convection in Bossiness approximation in variables temperature, a vorticity and a stream function. The laminar flows in the conjugate statement of problem are studied. Temperature fields, both in a fluid, and in rigid vertical walls are calculated.

articleTitle: Measurement of higher harmonics of current for rectifying devices by simulation modeling and MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper considers the problem of measurement of higher harmonics of current for rectifying devices during design with help of simulation models and MATLAB. The consumed current calculated by simulation model of the rectifying device is used in MATLAB where it is exposed to fast Fourier transform and harmonic analysis. Then power circuit and noise reducing filters optimization is performed based on results of consumed current Fourier analysis. Optimal solution within specified range of parameters giving minimal noise level is chosen.

articleTitle: Choice of numerical method for integration of navigation satellite movement equations
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Comparative analysis of numerical methods for integration of navigation satellite movement equations is presented in the paper. It is shown that Evehart methods is the most effective and accurate methods for such purposes.

articleTitle: Electric power supply system for power electric energy accumulators
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Electric power supply system (up to 3-4 GW in pulse) for electromagnetic mass accelerator is considered. Unique switch units for high current (up to 1.2 MA for voltage of up to 5 kV) are described. Paper describes various designs of mass accelerators and their power supply. Considered power supply source circuit variants include: unipolar DC current generator, and multiphase synchronous generator with controlled rectifier.

articleTitle: Effect of diffraction-limited divergence and wave front curvature of the Gaussian beam on Michelson interferometer fringes
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The investigation of the interference pattern that appears during the passage of a Gaussian beam through a Michelson interferometer was carried out. That allowed to find the length measurement error due to diffraction-limited divergence and wavefront curvature of the light beam.

articleTitle: IR-range coherent radiation source based on parametric light generator
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Parametric light generator based on AgGaS2 (AGS) with double pass excitation has been designed. Small nanosecond Nd:YLF laser operating on 1.053 mm wavelength was used as excitation source. Excitation pulse duration was 5-10 ns for maximal pulse energy of 540 mJ on frequency 0.1-5 kHz. Generation threshold was 91 mJ in the range 3.5 mm.

articleTitle: New approach to problem of the nature of mass and of energy
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the nature of mass is investigated. The new unit of the energy is proposed. Inertia of mass and inertia of energy are estimated identically. According to relativity theory the mass is transforming in energy and vice versa — energy is transforming in mass. The problem of the dark energy and the problem of the dark mass are coordinated from single bases.

articleTitle: Scattering of the holes in isotropic polycrystalline silicon and the calculation of effective masses of the charge carriers
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The Hamiltonian formulation for the process of the scattering of holes on the crystallite misorientations in isotropic polycrystalline silicon is described. This approach allows for the description of different scattering transitions: light holes to light holes, heavy holes to heavy holes, light holes to heavy holes, and heavy holes to light holes. The estimation of mass spectrum of holes and the calculation of the scattering probability of the holes on the crystallite misorientations in isotropic polycrystalline silicon are performed.

articleTitle: Effect of local increase of elements order on the accuracy of solution of stationary geoelectric problems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Problem of accuracy increase by local increase of order of finite elements is considered for the task of calculation of stationary electric field. The following three dimensional geoelectric problem is solved: 3D object is embedded in some media, grounded electric line is electric field source. Method of field part selection is used for solving. T-transform technique is used for matching finite elements of different orders. Three different basises were used with different placement of higher order finite elements. Obtained solutions were compared with solutions obtained on nested grids.

articleTitle: Metrological procurement for modeling conductivity of ultra thin dielectrics with non-uniform boundary by means of TCAD SENTAURUS
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Is developed the graphic and technological model of reprogrammed element memory of the actuation device of receiver Glonass navigator in the environment of SENTAURUS TCAD. Is calculation of distribution of electric fields in thin dielectrics on a surface of a shutter with a non-uniform horizontal and vertical profile of relief. The model can be used for calculation of electronic and ionic currents, of conductivity of a dielectric on a shutter depending on heterogeneity of border, definition of their limits parametr of element memory.

articleTitle: Generalized analysis of processes parameters measurement in SQM
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Based on the generalized model of measurement main equations for process measurement in SQM are obtained.

articleTitle: Using the hypercomplex numbers for instantaneous reactive power compensation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper provides an overview of the original and the modified p-q theory of instantaneous power applied to improve the energy performance of three-phase AC system. The report also addresses the allocation of inefficient components of instantaneous power in the algebra of hypercomplex num bers, which are subject to further compensation with shunt active power filters.

articleTitle: Vector controlled induction motor drive based on model predictive control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the application of the model predictive control (MPC) technique for controlling the speed of the induction motor drive. Vector control principle has been used for decoupling between motor speed and rotor flux. A simple model of induction motor is employed in the MPC structure so as to minimize the computational load. The MPC controller design is taken into account the effect of uncertainty due to motor parameters variation and load disturbance could be reduced. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme has been successfully verified through simulations. The performance of the system including the MPC controller is compared with the corresponding one using the traditional PI controller. The results proved that the induction motor with the MPC speed controller has superior transient response, and good robustness in face of uncertainties including load disturbance. Moreover, accurate tracking performance has been achieved.

articleTitle: Multilevel matrix converter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes a new topology of Matrix Converters with improved conversion and harmonic factors. The output voltage generation techniques are observed and basic states of the proposed circle are given and explained bellow.

articleTitle: The modeling of elastic waves propagation in an axisymmetric medium
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It's considered the possibilities of using variety models to describe the elastic wave propagation in an axisymmetric medium

articleTitle: Kalman filter for microstrip line inductance estimates refinement
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is shown that current strips method together with Kalman filtering decrease the confidence interval of the measured microstrip lines inductance values.

articleTitle: Oscillograph for digital control system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Design principles of digital control system with realtime data acquisition algorithm is considered. Possible realization of the algorithm for transmitting and processing information about operation of regulators of digital system controlling semiconductor converter being part of ground-based electric power generating system. Comparison of the results obtained by the proposed data analysis with the oscillograms obtained from experimental data is made.

articleTitle: Measurement of thickness and optical constants for metallic films used in optoelectronics
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Theoretical description and experimental detection of classical dimensional effects in the optical properties of thin metallic films is considered. We modeled and calculated quantitative influence of dimensional effects on dispersion law of refraction and damping coefficients of thin metallic films in wide range of wavelengths. Experiments were conducted on 5-50 nm nickel films obtained by thermal deposition. Laser ellipsometers with wavelengths of 632.8 nm and 488.2 nm were used for optical measurements. In addition, ellipsometric method for film thickness measurement is described. The method takes into account oxide layers on the surface of metals and estimates variation of optical parameters on the measurement. The method was applied to nickel and titanium films.

articleTitle: Application of models library for medical information systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Application of models library for health care information systems is considered. Description of basic objects of the library, principle of model ware storage and algorithms used for selection of a model for particular case are presented. Practical application of the library for decision making help is described on the example of the medical information system of Novosibirsk united registry of patients.

articleTitle: Improving power system stability using a fuzzy logic control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Power system stabilizers (PSSs) are added to excitation system to enhance the damping during low frequency oscillations. This paper presents a study of fuzzy logic power system stabilizer (PSS) for stability enhancement of a single machine power system. In order to accomplish the stability enhancement, two approaches to design Fuzzy Logic Power System Stabilizers (FLPSS) as follows: 1-FLC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> has Speed deviation and power angle as its input Δω and ΔPa. 2-FLC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> has Speed deviation and Acceleration as its input Δω and Δδ. The performance of these two approaches is compared and is compared with the system without PSS. The stabilizing signals were computed using the fuzzy membership functions depending on these variables. The simulations were tested under different operating conditions, also tested with different membership functions. The simulation results are quite encouraging and satisfactory.

articleTitle: Synthesis of multilevel bidirectional converters with switched capacitors
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of structural synthesis for multilevel bidirectional converters connecting DC and (or) AC voltage networks without the standard network transformer is offered. Such the converters are based on the concept of the controllable periodic series-parallel switching of capacitors and by means of transistors allow connecting capacitors either in series to a high-voltage network, or in parallel to a low-voltage network. The new circuits of the converters of all the basic classes, i.e. DC-DC, DC-AC, AC-DC, and AC-AC are created. Such the converters are intended for the new generation of the AC and the HVDC voltage electric locomotives, the big difference of voltages of the mains and the machine adjustable electric drive, and battery storages of electric energy.

articleTitle: Application neuronetwork technologies in IP-telephony
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The opportunity of application neuronetwork technologies in a IP-telephony is considered. The basic stages of an engineering technique of construction neuronetwork models are selected on the basis of an adaptive neural network.

articleTitle: Frequency-temporal filtering of the microseismic sources
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of division of the microseismic sources arising at hydraulic fracture, on duration of their frequency fragments is considered. For the problem solution short-time Fourier transform is used.

articleTitle: Creation of tunnel junction with scanning probe lithography
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Atomic force microscope was used to create nanosized oxide line crossing over the whole width a nickel oxide film based microstructure. The created structure revealed tunnel barrier type I-V characteristics.

articleTitle: A hybrid approach to electrical devices modeling
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the issues of hybrid systems modeling in the instrumental environment are considered. The algorithm for choosing the step, taking into account the dynamics of event-driven functions, is proposed. Described and analyzed a model of electrical devices in terms of hybrid systems.

articleTitle: Method of gamma-spectrum interpretation using vectorial approximation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A new method has been proposed to improve the procedure of gamma spectra interpretation. The procedure of spectra decomposing by the orthonormal basis and the way to obtain single spectral peak contribution have been developed.

articleTitle: An approach to the creation of geophysical measurement complex
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes the design and development of measurement system for magnetic observatories. The developed complex designed to work in standalone mode with minimal power consumption. As a communications medium stands Protocol CAN, which provides noise immunity of data transmission in real time, and scalability.

articleTitle: Composite fluorescent materials for luminescent solar concentrators — CdS quantum dots in a polymethylmethacrylate
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We study the spectral-luminescent properties of composites, containing cadmium sulfide quantum dots in the polymer matrix. It is shown that the modification of the polymer matrix high-boiling polar solvent leads to improved characteristics of the material. In the modified PMMA matrix CdS QDs efficiently emitting in the visible spectral region. The efficiency and the emission spectrum does not depend on the method of polymerization and the concentration of sulfur. The resulting materials are promising for use in luminescent solar concentrators.

articleTitle: Specificity of design and hardware implementation of humanoid robot
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper describes specificity of design and hardware implementation of humanoid robot. Description of main constructive units is presented. Software design for the robot control is considered.

articleTitle: The Call-center. Development of algorithm routings of calls
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Process of routing of calls is considered. On the basis of the data of system of monitoring and management of the Call-center calculation of an average timeout of the answer of the operator is executed. The generalized algorithm of routing of calls is developed.

articleTitle: Stabilization of DC component of bias current of n-p-n power MW transistors in common-base circuit
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Various types of diode-type stabilization of DC component of the bias current of power Si MW transistors in common-base circuit are considered. These types were used in real devices.

articleTitle: The tracking problem under parametrical uncertainty of reference model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper the tracking problem is considered for linear systems with unstable zero dynamic under unknown parameters reference model. The main idea is based on the implementation of discontinuous control inputs in the observer and identificator synthesis. The using of block control principle provides decomposition of synthesis problem into subproblems of the less dimensions.

articleTitle: Design of adaptive control system with unstable inverted plant design of adaptive controller for non minimum-phase system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this report the issue of the adaptive control of an unstable invered plant under the parameters disturbances is considered. The dynamic properties of the control system are discussed. Here are obtained and given the mathematic modeling results.

articleTitle: The algorithm of the texture periodicity matrix estimate based on the power spectrum analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The algorithm of the texture periodicity matrix estimate based on the power spectrum quantitative characteristics analysis was developed. The experimental studies results of developed algorithm were presented.

articleTitle: System effects of low-frequency wave strain and combined effects on neuromuscular structure back (LWS)
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article gives a variant of the biotechnical system with low-frequency mode of influence on the back neuromuscular structures, and how to use the system techniques which are more effective and accelerating recovery in the posttraumatic period for treatment and rehabilitation of spinal patients, including how to use them in sports medicine.

articleTitle: Design of devices for measurement of volume expansion coefficient and density of oil based products
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Problems of metrological procurement and design of devices for measurements of volume expansion coefficient and density of oil based products are considered.

articleTitle: The tracking problemunder parametrical uncertainty of reference model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper the problem of relays imperfections compensation is considered for so called second order sliding mode. The main idea is based on high frequency modulation of input signals of the relays. On the base of dynamic compensation approach and observer design the invariance problem is solved for bounded disturbances of prescribed class.

articleTitle: Investigation of surface nanostructures by reflected light method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Method for surface nanostructures analysis is considered. Information about the nanostructure is extracted from the shape of reflected very short laser pulses. The possibility of extracting the information is discussed.

articleTitle: Application of the localization principle in the synthesis of an extremum-seeking system for the model of thermionic converter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents synthesis technology of controller based on the localization principle for a model of control system of the operating mode of a thermionic energy converter by pressure cesium vapor. It is proposed to organize a two-circuit control. The controller of the inner loop based on the principle localization allows to stabilize a non-stationary dynamic part of the plant. The outer circuit ensures plants output convergences to the extremum value. Simulation study of the developed system is presented.

articleTitle: Control design under relay measurements
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The control problem of linear time-invariant systems under bank-bank measurements only is discussed. The main feature of the proposed algorithms is that the one's estimate the unknown continuous values of output variables and the further synthesis of the state observer with use of continuous estimations of output variables.

articleTitle: Analysis of optimal estimation algorithms efficiency of anisotropic textures orientation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Based on the Cramer-Rao inequality analysis of the potential accuracy of the estimate of anisotropic texture orientation observed on the background of additive white noise. The brightness function of the anisotropic texture with one dominant direction was approximated by a deterministic two-dimensional harmonic function. A method for analyzing the efficiency of optimal algorithms for estimating the orientation of anisotropic texture, allowing to determine the ultimate capabilities of methods based on the gradient structure tensor. The method is based on the Gaussian approximation for the components of the gradient structure tensor calculated in the frequency domain.

articleTitle: Biotechnical system for evaluating the spectrum of the human voice in normal conditions and in pathological conditions
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We have analyzed the spectrum of the human voice. And we evaluated the diagnostic method by the example of respiratory diseases and diseases of speech system.

articleTitle: Automatic broad-range transformer bridge for measurement of capacitance and dielectric loss tangent
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The precise transformer bridge have been designed that enables to transfer values of capacitance unit and dielectric loss tangent unit from basic reference standard to secondary and working reference standards of these units.

articleTitle: Modeling of the effect of silicon needles sharpening during their thermal oxidation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The thermal oxidation model developed using SProcess TCAD SenTaurus is considered. The cone-shaped silicon needle is used as a test structure. Simulation results show that the proposed model describes the phenomenon of the needle sharpening during their thermal oxidation in accordance with the experimental data. It is shown that for adequate modeling the consideration of some nonlinear mechanical effects is required.

articleTitle: Physical processes accompanied transcapillary exchange
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of many years study of physical processes in link of microhemocirculation using high sensitive physical methods are presented. Some of revealed phenomena allowed to suggest and to prove new concept of transcapillary exchange based on active interaction of blood with blood vessel.

articleTitle: Thermo-chemical parameters of metal nanopowders for oil based products properties modification
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Problems related to measurement of metal nanopowders thermo-chemical parameters are considered. The nanopowders are used for oil based products properties modification.

articleTitle: Analytical construction of a robust regulator by means of Lyapunov edge conditions
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A method is considered allowing to synthesize analytically robust control laws depending on a phase locus. System paths are not to exceed the bounds of this phase locus. The synthesis is being realized according to the so-called Lyapunov boundary conditions. The expression for these conditions is exactly the same that for the Lyapunov inequalities at a constraint function level surface. Control laws of desired type (linear, in particular) are determined analytically for an arbitrary system. Limitations on a technical implementation complexity (an order of a controller, as well as a number of components of a state vector) are also taken into account.

articleTitle: Ways of modernization of systems of electro-supply and electric equipment high-voltage electric locomotives of constant voltage
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Structures of converters for electric locomotives with DC high voltage (24kV) of catenaries and multimodule active rectifier scheme for high-voltage traction substations are considered. Multimodule active rectifier is used to provide electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) concern with the reduction of interference in feeding networks and catenaries.

articleTitle: Synthesis of broadband balancing devices using linked feeders
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Modified method for synthesis of broadband balancing transformer using three linked feeders is considered. Results of modeling balancing transformer with relative 80% pass band are presented..

articleTitle: Analysis and research of uncertainty of systems of metrological ensuring and management of production
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Any parametres have a relevant uncertainty in a real industrial process. Quality of measurements and quality of production are connected. If the quality of measurements does not satisfy requirements of technological process quality of the production is low.

articleTitle: An analysis of wire current distribution along an ends-fed dipole radiator
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel variation of the conventional dipole radiator is proposed and named as the ends-fed dipole radiator (EFDR). By properly choosing theirs parameters, it is possible to create the versions of the antenna that have suitable range of input resistance and figure-eight radiation patterns. The proposed antenna with relatively low profile and high polarization purity is very suitable candidate for mobile communication systems with single linear, dual linear or circular polarization.

articleTitle: More precise inductance by Kaiman filter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article for decrease confidence interval of experimental measurement data inductance of micro chip line is proposed to use Kalman filter. It is shown, that using Kalman filtration decrease confidence interval of experimental measurement data. Presence of this effect demonstrated competence using for special filtering experimental data end receiving from its more precise estimation of inductance micro chip line.

articleTitle: Termocompensation of tensoresistive sensors using bipolar junction transistor in extended temperature range
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article represents the results of mathematical modeling of thermocompensation scheme using bipolar junction transistor. Also it represents the result of temperature testing by experimental model in extended temperature range 25–2500C. It was shown that practical realization of this thermocompensation scheme is real for temperature up to 2500C and this method is capable of minimization temperature dependence of bridge output by ∼ 0,05-K),015%/0C.

articleTitle: Technique for interpretation of the secondary gamma radiation energy spectrum based on vector approximation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The proposed technique significantly simplifies interpretation of secondary gamma radiation energy spectra obtained when specimen are irradiated with gamma quanta. The procedure of representation of the spectrum in the orthonormal basis is developed as well as the method of extracting individual contributions of separate spectral lines.

articleTitle: Forecasting of undesired events in computer system with help of dynamical model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We suggest using linear discrete stochastic model in the form of states space for forecasting number of incidents in enterprise system of informational security (IS). Algorithm for the model is described. In accordance with the model and with the Kalman filter equations calculation of estimates for forecast and filtration with respect to the number of IS incidents is performed.

articleTitle: Application of numerical methods for modeling nonlinear effects in optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Main nonlinear effects in optical fiber are discussed. Special attention is paid to physical description and methods of mathematical modeling.

articleTitle: Optimization of systems of metrological procurement and production control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Modern multi-element automated systems require higher reliability. Reliability for complex systems often is the most critical criterion for their feasibility.

articleTitle: Comparison of dual Z-source inverter and traditional PWM inverters for aircraft power generation system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The dual Z-Source inverter is considered. The simulation results of the aircraft variable-speed/ con stant frequency power generation system with the dual Z-source inverter are presented. A compari son of this system and the system with Pulse-Width Modulated (PWM) voltage source inverter and the system which consists of the PWM voltage source inverter and the dc-dc boosted converter is made.

articleTitle: Modeling coaxial waveguide adapter for magnetron MW generator
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Model of coaxial waveguide adapter for power tapping from MW power generator is considered. Probe embedded in the waveguide is continuation of coaxial of cathode terminal of magnetron. Results of optimization are represented as graphs where the best SWC=1.197 at λ/4 distance from back grounded wall of the waveguide.

articleTitle: Video solitons in a nonlinear dispersive transmission line with loss
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New modification of printed-circuit antenna is considered. The antenna allows decreasing size comaring to well known printed-circuit director antennas. The antenna was optimized by computer simulation. Paper also considers main features of directivity characteristics of director antenna as well as antenna impedance matching. Optimization was performed for central frequency 1.85 GHz. After optimization the antenna appeared to have smaller size comparing to known antennas. Thus it can be used in wireless telecommunication systems.

articleTitle: Invariant method of fight with a selective fading
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The analysis of qualitative parameters of invariant system is made at a noncorrelation of counting of noise and existence of a selective fading. The probability of paired transition of invariants is calculated. The structure of invariant system is offered.

articleTitle: Physics hypercumulation and comdined shaped charges
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The novel points of view to the formation of shaped charge jets are described. The physics of so-called hypercumulation are described in details and confirmed by numerical simulations. It has been shown that hypercumulation effects allow to increase both the speed and mass of a cumulative jets much more than the theory by Lavrentyev-Birkhoff predict. The applications of novel effects are the oil-well perforations.

articleTitle: A review of tests for exponentiality
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A wide selection of tests for exponentiality is considered. Distributions of test statistics under true null hypothesis are studied and power of tests is estimated by means of methods of statistical simulation. A comparative analysis of power of tests with respect to competing alternatives with different shapes of hazard rate function is conducted. The conclusions are made on preference of one test or another under presence of specific competing alternatives.

articleTitle: Some considerations of via stitching impact on parasitic coupling of RF multiports in multilayer packages and MCMs
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Electromagnetic cavity-resonance modes in parallel-plate planes of power and ground rectangular structures along with parasitic coupling between excitation RF multiports are investigated. Such structures are widely used in microwave multilayer packages, MCMs and could be the source of considerable electromagnetic interference (EMI). Effective methods should be applied for damping and elimination of the radiated fields, especially in small areas and volumes. The investigated three-layered LTCC microwave package (QFN-type) possesses two separate grounding planes on different levels, connected through multiple shielding vias. The estimation of the electromagnetic field distribution is conducted by full-wave analysis of the proposed cavity-resonance models and corresponding S-parameters are extracted. This paper also discusses the influence of matrixlike via grid distribution on the propagation constant and effective dielectric permittivity of exemplary structures in the frequency band of interest − 10 to 30 GHz.

articleTitle: Peculiarity of multi-reflector filtering technology (invited)
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper makes a review of different basic photonic structures which built the fundamentals of multi-reflector filtering technology aimed to develop optical tunable devices with multi-hundreds reconfigurable wavelength channels. It presents recent results of numerical investigation of novel widely tunable acousto-optic filters on LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and thermo-optic tunable filters and reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexers (ROADMs) on silicon-on-insulator (SOI) structures employing multi-reflector beam expanders. An original design of structures that utilizes one-dimensional photonic crystals, 2D-grating, nano-grooves, and/or p-n-doping to provide better manufacturability are discussed.

articleTitle: Fundamental problems and results bound with electron dynamics
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Clause is devoted to tasks and progress in exploration of the electron from its discovery up today. Important line of the account is the authors conception and theory also its applications. Examples are brought that demonstrate the possibilities of the receipt the scientific results. New interpretation of the energetic ratio for relativistic electron is performed. New results applied to the power devices and to interpretation of the astrophysical data.

articleTitle: Review of exponentiality criteria
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Number of criteria for examining hypothesis on exponentiality of probability distribution is considered. By the methods of statistical modeling distributions of statistics are investigated. The examined hypothesis is supposed true, estimates are calculated and comparative analysis for power of the criteria with respect to alternatives having different shapes of failure intensity function is conducted. Conclusions on feasibility of different criteria are presented.

articleTitle: Goodness of fit criteria for checking adequacy of parametric models for reliability and survivalability
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Investigation of statistics distributions for nonparametric goodness of fit criteria (Kolmogorov, Kramer-Mizes-Smirnov, Anderson-Darling) is considered for checking adequacy of parametric models for reliability and survivalability over censored samplings. Algorithms are developed for checking simple and complex goodness of fit hypotheses.

articleTitle: Open waveguide resonators for gaseous dielectrics parameters control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Metal-dielectric waveguide resonators of limiting type are considered. Results of the research on a possibility of using such resonators for MW measurements, in particular for measurements and control of gaseous dielectrics parameters even in the flow state, are presented.
