articleTitle: Bridge circuits with balancing by grounded controlled elements
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article gives the proof to four-arm bridge electric circuits with impulse power and balancing by only grounded controlled elements. They conserved their property of separate balancing. The summary — questions of realization of is discrete-adaptive thermoindemnification of parameters of photo diodes in a photointake using photodiode inclusion of a photodetector, thus a element sensitive to radiation are considered is the temperature gage.

articleTitle: Some properties of extremal two-channel system with feedback derivatives
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The synthesis problem of extremal control system for two-channel nonstationary object with unimodal static characteristic is considered basing on the localization method. By using the corresponding regulator in each channel the required quality of transient processes is achieved. The author studied the infuence that horizontal drift of extremal characteristic and noise measurements of output variables of the system made on the quality of processes in a system and achieving the extremum. This dependence was proved by numerical modeling.

articleTitle: Registration of digital signals of data transmission on the basis of fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Registration of digital signals of data transmission on the basis of fuzzy logic with use of the designed aprioristic fuzzy scale are considers

articleTitle: Applying S-graphs for modeling metrological support and control systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Graphic presentation of metrological support and industry control systems is based on a structural configuration where separate elements are 2n-pole networks. The above-mentioned structural elements by formal operations are presented as flow graphs. To get graphic models we suggest using S-graph structures which are based on scatter matrix. SM contains all the information about the system behavior, fulfills the condition of normalization of probabilities and causality principle.

articleTitle: Analysis of synchronizing methods for wireless telecommunication network
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Analysis of synchronizing methods for wireless telecommunication network functioning in limited space is considered.

articleTitle: Sfigmografichesky transmitter signal arterial pulsation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the sphygmography measuring converter of distal arterial pulse signal which provides acquisition and processing of peripheral distal arterial pulse signal based on methods of volume compression oscillometry. The features of the structural construction of the transmitter were considered, the main sources of noise were analyzed. The optimal bandwidth of band-pass filter was substantiated.

articleTitle: Analysis of the temporal features of children's voice-speech samples
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of the temporal characteristics analysis of 9–10 years old children's speech samples are presented. These samples were classified into relative groups “norm” and “deviation” by means of an expert evaluation method. The distribution of samples in the rate of speech was obtained. Temporal parameters, which can allow to get an objective characteristics of the voice signals and classify them into groups “normal” and “deviation” are discussed.

articleTitle: Electro-physical properties of water under physicochemical impact
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Problems related to measurements of electro-physical properties of prepared water are considered.

articleTitle: Method of estimation of injection level of meat materials
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the method of estimation of injection level of meat materials, based on measurement meat polarization signal and calculating parameters of non-linear regression, and the device for it's conduction are discussed.

articleTitle: Autonomous power supply system with floating frequency of stabilized AC voltage based on asynchronous generator and compensator of reactive power based on current inverter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Possibility to build airplane autonomous power supply system based on asynchronous generator is considered. Use of semiconductor current inverter for driving the asynchronous generator together with voltage stabilization for various rotor rotation velocity and with compensation of generator voltage distortions caused by nonlinearity or nonsymmetry of load represent an innovative solution. Autonomous current inverter (unlike voltage inverter it does not have electrolyte capacitor causing well known limitations) is used as converter.

articleTitle: Synthesis method for broadband switch devices
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Method for synthesis for broadband switch power amplifiers and frequency multipliers is proposed. The method is based on generalized mathematical model of switch devices and characteristic parameters of ideal wattles four terminal unit matching arbitrary impedances of signal source and load. It allows choosing structure of characteristic functions for output matching function and finding its parameters.

articleTitle: The optimization of metrological systems of ensuring and management of production
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The reliability requirements for modern systems, consisting of numerous elements and largely automated, are not easy to follow. Unlike with simple devices the reliability of modern goods is in many cases the main criterion in evaluating whether their production is profitable.

articleTitle: Modified dipole type antenna
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New dipole type antenna fed from waveguide is designed using method of moments and induced electromotive forces. Numeric and experimental results are presented. In order to drive arm of antenna with waveguide WR-430 two equal magnitude anti-phase signals are used. Since the space around the antenna if free of conductors (excluding infinite grounded plane) the antenna is a good candidate for high polarization quality radiation source. Such antenna can be used as basic element for antenna array or single irradiator.

articleTitle: Temperature stability enhancement of SAW devices
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The different methods, improving the temperature stability of functional SAW devices such as fil ters, oscillators are considered.

articleTitle: Pulse current trimming of polysilicon piezoresistors in pressure sensor
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The influence of current trimming conditions on the resistance change was researched. Current trimming method may be used for the offset reduction in pressure sensor. This method may be used after chip assembling and do not requires the use of costly equipment. Samples with different dopping concentration were researched. Their behavior during pulse current trimming was variously. The practical methodology of Wheatstone bridge balancing was offer. The qualitatively description of obtained experimental results was presented.

articleTitle: One of the possibilities of the disease diagnosing by the electrical method based on the Su Jok System
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the possibility of the early detection of diseases based on the Su Jok System using the electrical resistance of points of correspondence. Researches have shown that the electrical resistance of the points of correspondence becomes less than the resistance of surrounding points before pathological signs appear which means the possibility of early diagnosis.

articleTitle: On accuracy of Fabry Perot interferometer (p.1: Stationary illumination)
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Accuracy parameters for Fabry Perot interferometer are determined. Numerical estimate of parameters responsible for total accuracy are presented.

articleTitle: Research of interrelation between parameters of process in electromagnetic converter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of an experimental research of change of a current and moving in stationary electrome chanical process of the electromagnetic converter are submitted.

articleTitle: Models for systems of metrological procurement and production processes control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Development of industrial processes automation and demands for accurate managerial solutions require advanced systems of metrological procurement. Appropriate mathematical models are developed for the systems of metrological procurement and production control.

articleTitle: Synthesis of multilevel bidirectional converters with switched capacitors
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The method of structural synthesis for multilevel bidirectional converters connecting DC and (or) AC voltage networks without the standard network transformer is offered. Such the converters are based on the concept of the controllable periodic seriesparallel switching of capacitors and by means of transistors allow connecting capacitors either in series to a high-voltage network, or in parallel to a low-voltage network. The new circuits of the converters of all the basic classes, i.e. DC-DC, DC-AC, AC-DC, and AC-AC are created. Such the converters are intended for the new generation of the AC and the HVDC voltage electric locomotives, the big difference of voltages of the mains and the machine adjustable electric drive, and battery storages of electric energy.

articleTitle: Multi-channel in-phase adder-power divider of Wilkinson type with a correction stub
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Analysis of the modified circuit of the multi-channel in-phase adder-power divider of Wilkinson type with connection to the common point of the ballast resistors of short-circuited line stub is considered The circuit enables to compensate parasitic parameters of the resistors and to improve de vice parameters.

articleTitle: Advantage of DVB-T2 and constructing it using DVB-T equipment
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Advantages of digital television broadcasting standard DVB-T2 with respect to DVB-T are considered. It is shown that modernization is possible by changing program code.

articleTitle: A modified dipole-like antenna
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A novel waveguide-fed dipole-like antenna is based on the method of moments and induced electromotive forces. Practical application is illustrated through the numerical and experimental investigations of the antenna. To excite the arms of an antenna the two equi-magnitude π out-of phase excitations are created by using the standard WR-430 waveguide. Since the area around the radiating arms is free of any conductors (with the exception of an infinite ground plane), the proposed antenna is a good candidate to create the high polarization purity of radiation. Such an antenna may be used as the building block in the design of any E-arrayed arrays as well as the standalone radiators.

articleTitle: Determination of parameters of 3-point matrix imitator as superposition of 2-point models
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Equations for calculating magnitudes of signals fed to irradiators of matrix imitator in order to obtain required position of apparent radiation center are obtained.

articleTitle: Technology for electronic temperature compensation of photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We consider the problems of discrete-adaptive temperature compensation of photodiodes' parameters in the photosensitive device that uses the photodetector in a photo-diode-like manner. The photosensitive element itself is used as the temperature sensor.

articleTitle: Mechanics of atomic-ether recording and representation of information
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Analysis of a digital image of an atomic structure and mechanics of atomic-ether recording and representation of information is considered.

articleTitle: Increase of accuracy for estimate of distributed irregularities in optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of modeling the effect of Brillouin scattering on distributed irregularities in optical fiber waveguides are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis and study of uncertainties of the models for systems of metrological procurement and production control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Al parameters of real production have some uncertainty. There exists a correlation between quality of measurements and quality of products. Where measurement quality is higher products also have higher quality.

articleTitle: Improving characteristics of director antennas with unipolar feed
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New modification of printed-circuit antenna is considered. The antenna allows decreasing size comaring to well known printed-circuit director antennas. The antenna was optimized by computer simulation. Paper also considers main features of directivity characteristics of director antenna as well as antenna impedance matching. Optimization was performed for central frequency 1.85 GHz. After optimization the antenna appeared to have smaller size comparing to known antennas. Thus it can be used in wireless telecommunication systems.

articleTitle: Calculation of ring adder with linked feeder section
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Ring circuit is considered where the section of 3/4λ length is changed with section of 1/4λ length. Linked feeder lines are used with two short circuited terminals located on diagonal.

articleTitle: Determination of temporal positions of signals in seismic guard systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: By means of digital statistical simulation we analyze effect of input parameters estimates errors on the accuracy of determination of temporal position of seismic signal caused in ground by moving human.

articleTitle: Research of the influence of air humidity at the pictures of gas discharge images of the small area
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper was considered the influence of humidity of air at the pictures of gas discharge images of the small area (metal and skin). It has shown that the humidity of the air affected at the picture of a gas discharge.

articleTitle: Software for selection of parameters for differentiating second order filter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Possibilities of selecting parameters of characteristic polynomial of differentiating filter are considered. The selection should provide required quality of the filter and fast response of automated control system. Roots of the characteristic equation of the automated control system are dependent on the requirements to quality of the transition processes. Area occupied by possible values of the polynomial is analytically and graphically determined on the basis of correspondence between the area of the polynomial roots and its coefficients. Software for automation of selection of characteristic polynomial coefficients for differentiating filter is described.

articleTitle: Analysis the method for setting digital equalizer
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Digital corrector adjustment method in adaptive mode is analyzed. Method based on using of left-circulant matrix, composed from circuit's pulse characteristic and discrete Fourier transform.

articleTitle: Converters of distributed power supply system with higher electromagnetic compatibility
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper considers converters for power supply of railways contact lines with DC voltage of 3.3 kV. The converters have better electromagnetic compatibility characteristics with longitudinal 24kV DC line in systems of distributed power supply.

articleTitle: A new class of welding machines
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes a welding inverter, which provides AC on an ultrasonic frequency. In contrast to existing DC inverters it is more efficient and produces better welded joints. In the article we mention the schematics of the inverter's power circuits. This schematics uses resonant method of arc ignition. The article contains a study of this kind of arc ignition. The discussed welding inverter can be used for inducting metal warming.

articleTitle: Calculation of characteristics for meander system with choke support using theory of four-terminal elements
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is suggested to use equivalent circuits consisting of serially connected four-terminal elements for calculation of electrodynamic characteristics of slowing structure represented by meander with choke support. This approach allows conducting analysis of modifications. Comparison of calculated values and experimental values is presented.

articleTitle: Novel multi-splitting widely tunable filter on SOI technology
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper proposes and makes numerical investigation of new tunable optical filter which utilized multiple coupled silicon wire waveguides on SOI structures. Numerical simulation by 2D FDTD proves its general conception and demonstrates that a short 321 μm structure with 32 couplers has spectral resolutions 1.7 nm, loss −1 dB and side-lobes below −26 dB. It provides wavelength tuning (without Vernier principle) within total FSR 36.8 nm at central optical wavelength 1.55 μm by temperature change up to 100 C° in four sets of thermo optic phase shifters. Device of 1 cm size provides 0.05 nm filter linewidth. Filter can be manufactured by CMOS compatible technology and very promising for applications in photonics.

articleTitle: Design of devices for power pulse magnitude control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Four circuits of device for power unipolar pulse magnitude control are considered. The devices are built on bipolar transistors. Operation and design of the circuits are discussed. Realization and experimental data are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of MEMT operation in a bridge circuit under random excitations
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Results of the analysis of the operation of two-capacitor bridge microelectromechanical transducer (MEMT), converting mechanical vibrations energy into electrical energy, are presented for the conditions of random excitations and taking into account mutual interaction of electrical and mechanical forces. The method for estimation of the MEMT energy characteristics for the case of random excitation is proposed. For two types of excitation source the estimates for the power dissipated on the load are obtained.

articleTitle: Influence radiation-convection heat transfer on temperature fields in crystals in a Czochralski method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The conjugated heat transfer in regimes of a thermogravitational convection of gas and radiation-convection heat exchange in system «a crystal — environment — walls of the growth chambers», geometrically similar upper part of a thermal knot in a Czochralski method is numerically investigated. Calculations are fulfilled in a range of Grashof numbers from 1000 to 16000 at Prandtl number Pr = 0,68. Researches are spent by a finite element method. Calculation of radiation fluxes was made by a zonal method. The relative role of thermal conductivity, a convective heat transfer and a radiation heat exchange is investigated.

articleTitle: Measurement of passive 6-pole element S-parameters by triple 12-pole reflectometer
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Method for measurement of passive 6-pole element S parameters by triple 12-pole reflectometer is proposed. The method is based solution of equations obtained after measurement of complex reflection coefficients. The problem is not only to obtain the equations but also to determine structural parameters of the meters. In the paper main attention is put to the equations. The calibration of the meters is not considered.

articleTitle: Using the Euler-Krylov angles for the linear transformation of the phase variable basis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The report focuses on the mathematical description for the linear transformation of the three-phase variable referenceframe on the basis Euler-Krylov angles. This approach makes it possible to decompose an orthonormal basis rotation for the final three moving and makes a visualinterpretation of transformation to a new state space.

articleTitle: Design of programmable interpolation filter for ULSI digital modulator-converter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Model for programmable interpolation filter is developed in Matlab environment. Calculation of digital filters, digit alignment units, filter optimization for power efficiency have been made. The proposed filter is used in ULSI IC of digital quadrature modulator-converter for interpolation of input signal with subsequent modulation of carrying frequency.

articleTitle: Variants of practical realization of the electric drive with asynchronized switched motor
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In article variants of hardware realization of system of vector management by the electric drive on a basis asynchronized switched motor with use of modern element base are considered, and also application possibility as current inverter, and inverter of pressure for a food of windings stator is shown. The analysis of modern controlers for systems of the electric drive is given and the variant of debugging of the developed algorithms on imitating Simulink-model of the electric car is offered.

articleTitle: Study of superlong-period oscillations of earth by high-sensitive laser method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For the first time the analysis of correlation of deformation processes in spatially separated points of the Earth “Talgar” (Kazakhstan) — “Talaya” (Baikal rift zone) is carried out. The earth-wide mechanism of the excitation of superlongperiod oscillations of with the period 1 hour is confirmed. About it both spectra of fluctuations, and variations in time of spectra of deformation and atmospheric fluctuations testify. The fact of interrelation between superlong-period deformation oscillations of the Earth and atmospheric pressure variations in spatially separated points is established. This fast denotes the general source of these fluctuations — shift fluctuations of the internal kernel of the Earth.

articleTitle: Design features of signal processing schemes of amplitude reflektometric fiber-optic pressure sensors
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper design features of signal processing schemes of amplitude reflektometric fiber-optic pressure sensors are presented.

articleTitle: The inertial thermonuclear fusion is feasible owing to development of thin films technologies
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An idea of inertial thermonuclear synthesis consists in accumulation of energy and subsequent almost instantaneous transformation of that energy into heat within a small milligram - scale dt-capsule (a mixture of deuterium and tritium in solid freezed state). One can, however, go another way by accumulating the kinetic energy in dt-capsule itself by accelerating it. The velocities needed are of the order of one million meters per second, corresponding to optimal temperature of the thermonuclear reaction ~10-20 keV, if that energy can be transformed into heat by striking the target within the reactor or by collision with a similar oncoming capsule. It is important to note that in this case an opportunity appears to deliver the fuel into reactor still hot after previous micro-blow. Obviously, the ignition of thermonuclear reaction can be achieved by bombardment of dt-target by solid body. The outlined idea was proposed almost fifty years ago. An investigation into various methods of macroparticle acceleration demonstrated that to implement the idea accelerators of enormous size are necessary, which made its practical application quite conjectural. However, even today it is technologically feasible to create the required macroparticle accelerators of the order of 100-1000 meter long in case part of the macroparticle is made of super-thin superconducting films or ionic superconductor.

articleTitle: Analysis of dissipative systems using nonlinear programming
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The possibility of non-linear programming method for the analysis of dissipative systems with con centrated parameters tained non-reactive elements and the use of this approach for the calculation of many arms of river channels with general purpose software tools for mathematical calculations (MathCad, MatLab etc.)

articleTitle: Comparison of calculation of the induced polarization field for a perfect circular electric dipole installation and the installation, consisting of eight horizontal electric lines
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article it's carried out the comparison of the calculation results of the induced polarization field for the perfect circular electric dipole installation and the installation, consisting of eight horizontal electric lines. It's shown that both approaches give enough close result.

articleTitle: Measurement of electric power quality index for uninterruptible power supply devices
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper presents algorithm for computer aided design of AC power supply systems for feeding telecommunication equipment. The algorithm takes into consideration operation of reserve power station together with uninterruptible power supply source. Simulation models of power supply systems are developed for transient modes during input and output switching and allow to measure level of electromagnetic interference. Real CAD system for power supply of radio relay lines is described.

articleTitle: Model for transport flows control by measurements of temporal parameters of traffic light
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is proposed to control transport flow on a single crossroad by changing duration of red/green light keeping the total cycle time constant. To obtain data modeling experiment has been carried out during which further optimization of traffic light control parameters has been performed.

articleTitle: The input converter of an off-line power-supply system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The experimental results of the input converter with high-frequency intermediate link are given in this paper. The input converter is a part of an off-line power-supply system and consists of con trolled rectifier and DC/DC converter. The implementation of high-frequency power circuit is based on a modular approach.

articleTitle: Precision measurement of the refractive index of transparent optical media
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: We propose the method for measuring of refractive index, based on the determination of the freq uency shift of a given Fabry-Perot interferometer bandwidth, when the space between the mirrors is evacuated or filled with the investigated medium.

articleTitle: Comparison of dual Z-source inverter and traditional PWM inverters for aircraft power generation system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The dual Z-Source inverter is considered. The simulation results of the aircraft variable-speed/ constant frequency power generation system with the dual Z-source inverter are presented. A comparison of this system and the system with Pulse-Width Modulated (PWM) voltage source inverter and the system which consists of the PWM voltage source inverter and the dc-dc boosted converter is made.

articleTitle: Convection-diffusion problem solving by stabilized finite element methods
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Stabilized finite element methods application for the solution of of convection — diffusion problems is investigated. Features of algorithms of SUPG and RFB methods are discussed. Restrictions in application of these methods at the solution of filtration and adsorption problems are analyzed.

articleTitle: Interaction in the language of resource redistribution
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is shown that at the description of interactions the language of resource redistribution is incomplete without enlisting a passive and, on the contrary, within the limits of DIS-technology it agrees with practice more fully than traditional approaches. The actuality of the account of an infrastructure is proved also.

articleTitle: Improving power system stability using a fuzzy logic control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Power system stabilizers (PSSs) are added to excitation system to enhance the damping during low frequency oscillations. This paper presents a study of fuzzy logic power system stabilizer (PSS) for stability enhancement of a single machine power system. In order to accomplish the stability enhancement, two approaches to design Fuzzy Logic Power System Stabilizers (FLPSS) as follows: 1-FLC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> has Speed deviation and power angle as its input Δω and ΔPa. 2-FLC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> has Speed deviation and Acceleration as its input Δω and Δδ. The performance of these two approaches is compared and is compared with the system without PSS. The stabilizing signals were computed using the fuzzy membership functions depending on these variables. The simulations were tested under different operating conditions, also tested with different membership functions. The simulation results are quite encouraging and satisfactory.

articleTitle: Optical properties and growth of rhombic and trigonal crystals of potassium nitrate
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)

articleTitle: Sliding mode control of vector controlled induction motor drive
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the speed control of the induction motor drive. The control strategy is based on the sliding mode technique. The decoupling between motor speed and rotor flux amplitude has been achieved using the field orientation principle. The control law has been designed such that the uncertainty due to motor parameters variation can be eliminated. Also, the chattering problem associated with classical sliding mode control has been solved by suggesting an adaptive load torque disturbance estimator. Digital simulations have been carried out in order to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme. The induction motor with the proposed controller has been tested through mismatched rotor resistance, and load torque disturbance. The results prove that the induction motor with the proposed controller has good robustness in face of uncertainties including load disturbance. Moreover, accurate tracking performance has been achieved.

articleTitle: A new class of welding machines
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes a welding inverter, which provides AC on an ultrasonic frequency. In contrast to existing DC inverters it is more efficient and produces better welded joints. In the article we mention the schematics of the inverter's power circuits. This schematics uses resonant method of arc ignition. The article contains a study of this kind of arc ignition. The discussed welding inverter can be used for inducting metal warming.

articleTitle: Multilevel regulators for DC current based on structures with switching capacitors
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Design principles of multilevel continuous pulse-width regulators for DC current based on step-up and step-down two-directional capacitor converters of resonance type are considered. Regulators have enhanced efficiency, small size, low harmonic distortion of input and output currents. In addition they have linear control and rigid external characteristics, and are capable of energy recuperation from load to primary line.

articleTitle: Parametric interaction of microwave guide with nanomechanical resonator
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the calculation of dynamic and fluctuation characteristics of nanoelec-tromechanical system which represents microwave strip resonator interacting by means of parametric capacitance with the low frequency nanomechanical oscillator. In the linear approximation to the displacement of the capacitance plate of the mechanical resonator we obtain the analytical expressions for the oscillation amplitude of nanomechanical resonator, its effective damping and frequency detuning, spectral density of its displacement fluctuations as the functions of the driving microwave frequency and the input microwave power. In addition, we calculate the voltage-frequency characteristics and fluctuation spectrum for the output low frequency modulation signal which is caused by the influence of mechanical oscillator. The results obtained in the paper can be useful for the development of supersensitive devices based on nanomechanical resonators.

articleTitle: New approach to problem of the nature of mass and of energy
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the nature of mass is investigated. The new unit of the energy is proposed. Inertia of mass and inertia of energy are estimated identically. According to relativity theory the mass is transforming in energy and vice versa - energy is transforming in mass. The problem of the dark energy and the problem of the dark mass are coordinated from single bases.

articleTitle: A comparison of a continuous and a discontinuous Galerkin methods applied to a single-phase flow problem in anisotropic porous media
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A model of single-phase flow of slightly compressible liquid is studied and the discontinuous and the continuous Galerkin methods for this model are compared. After studying the results of comparison, one may make conclusion that both method produce solutions that mostly are in accord with laws of physics. However, computational costs for the continuous method are less than ones for the discontinuous method, and the discontinuous method may produce non-physical jumps in solutions on initial time layers.

articleTitle: Multilevel Matrix converter
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes a new topology of Matrix Converters with improved conversion and harmonic factors. The output voltage generation techniques are observed and basic states of the proposed circle are given and explained bellow.

articleTitle: The fiber-optic channel leakage of audio information
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper gives a general description of the principle of forming the channel leakage from the physical point of view and taking into account the hardware methods of data transmission. Considered the most vulnerable sections of the fiber-optic communication lines, the possible actions the attacker, and some preventive approaches to ensure the safety of the line. A description of the experimental stand, necessary for the next stages of work.

articleTitle: Investigation and development of optical filters using fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Optical filters on the fiber Bragg grating (FBG) allow to create compact input-output multiplexers with low interchannel transitions for systems with wavelength-division multiplexing. This article discusses the optical filters with one and two FBG. The calculation of the optical filter and built its transfer function, phase response and spectral sensitivity of the FBG.

articleTitle: Automatic algorithms for 3D human body surface reconstruction by a computer optical topography
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to processing algorithms of strips images, obtained by a computer optical topography, for 3D human body model reconstruction. This algorithms implements in the TODP medical system, which intended for diagnostic of postural disorders and widely used in Russian orthopedics.

articleTitle: Ways of modernisation of systems of electro-supply and electric equipment high-voltage electric locomotives of constant voltage
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Structures of converters for electric locomotives with DC high voltage (24kV) of catenaries and multimodule active rectifier scheme for high-voltage traction substations are considered. Multimodule active rectifier is used to provide electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) concern with the reduction of interference in feeding networks and catenaries.

articleTitle: A printed dipole phased array
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A numerical analysis of the printed dipole phased array is presented. The rules of the pattern formations and an impedance transformation are considered.

articleTitle: Problems of monitoring and early diagnostics in branched fiber optic networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper describes solutions to the following problems: centralized documenting of the network cables, continuous monitoring of communication lines state, early detecting degradation and damage of optic fibers for subsequent their repair.

articleTitle: Cascade observer synthesis with sigmoid functions
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problems of invariant tracking problem for nonlinear under parametrical uncertainty and incomplete miserable are considered. The effective method of the synthesis of the state space observer and external and parametrical disturbances extraction is sliding mode technique. In this paper the discontinuous actions in the observer are approximated by the sigmoid actions as a limit approximation of discontinuous functions. It is shown, that approximation of sigmoid functions allows to solve the observer synthesis problem with high accuracy and possibly better in comparison with discontinuous actions.

articleTitle: Kalman filter for precision estimate inductance of micro chip line
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: It is shown that using data the method of Current Trips in conjunction with Kalman filtration decrease confidence interval of the experimental measurement data inductance of micro chip line.

articleTitle: The thermometer with built in MTSH-90
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The principle of action and structure of the thermometer containing virtual model MTSH-90 which carries out functions of a multiple-valued measure for analog-digital transformation and interpolation of values of entrance temperature are described.

articleTitle: Worn by the system of assessment of condition of the sportsman in view of the pace of running at medium and long distances
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This article describes the appliances to monitor the training process of athlete's medium and long distances, indicating that they belong in the sport, which will improve the results of our Russian team in athletics at the global level.

articleTitle: Application neuronetwork technologies in IP-telephony
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The opportunity of application neuronetwork technologies in a IP-telephony is considered. The basic stages of an engineering technique of construction neuronetwork models are selected on the basis of an adaptive neural network.

articleTitle: The fast determination of amplitude and phase frequency characteristics electrical objects
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For increase of accuracy of numerical definition for impedance of researched objects on signals of influence and response is offered, before application to them of Fast Fourier Transformation, to use smoothing experiment data by interpolation spline of Lagrange of the third degree.

articleTitle: Control design under relay measurements
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The control problem of linear time-invariant systems under bank-bank measurements only is discussed. The main feature of the proposed algorithms is that the one's estimate the unknown continuous values of output variables and the further synthesis of the state observer with use of continuous estimations of output variables.

articleTitle: Stochastic methods in providing network security
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the successful implementation of the stochastic methods of information network security in the form of a firewall with intellectual and adaptive properties based on genetic algorithms and the use of “traps”.

articleTitle: Invariant method for controlling frequency selective fading
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Analysis of qualitative parameters of invariant system for the case of non-correlated noise sampling and presence of frequency selective fading is made. Probability for pair transfer of invariants is calculated. Structure of invariant system is proposed.

articleTitle: The inertial thermonuclear fusion is feasible owing to development of thin films technologies
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An idea of inertial thermonuclear synthesis consists in accumulation of energy and subsequent almost instantaneous transformation of that energy into heat within a small milligram — scale dt-capsule (a mixture of deuterium and tritium in solid freezed state). One can, however, go another way by accumulating the kinetic energy in dt-capsule itself by accelerating it. The velocities needed are of the order of one million meters per second, corresponding to optimal temperature of the thermonuclear reaction ∼ 10–20 keV, if that energy can be transformed into heat by striking the target within the reactor or by collision with a similar oncoming capsule. It is important to note that in this case an opportunity appears to deliver the fuel into reactor still hot after previous micro-blow. Obviously, the ignition of thermonuclear reaction can be achieved by bombardment of dt-target by solid body. The outlined idea was proposed almost fifty years ago. An investigation into various methods of macroparticle acceleration demonstrated that to implement the idea accelerators of enormous size are necessary, which made its practical application quite conjectural. However, even today it is technologically feasible to create the required macroparticle accelerators of the order of 100–1000 meter long in case part of the macroparticle is made of super-thin superconducting films or ionic superconductor.

articleTitle: Various algorithms using brain electromagnetic radiation spectrum for diagnostics and treatment of some diseases
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Paper presents algorithms for registration of brain electromagnetic radiation by contact and contactless methods, accumulation of parameters of rhythms (λ, β, γ and others), calculation of their reverse transform, and comparison of shape, magnitude and frequency of brain signals of diseased and healthy human.

articleTitle: Measurement of derivative on random noise background
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Method for measurement of a signal derivative and estimation of the approximation error are considered. The optimal sampling size for a specified noise level is also discussed.

articleTitle: Dual-channel Pid-controller synthesis for the system “inverted pendulum — Cart”
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The synthesis controller for an inverted pendulum on a cart, for the case when the moment of inertia of the pendulum can be neglected. The simulation results obtained in an environment of Simulink.

articleTitle: Research and development of automatic control system of wind power plant
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: When creating a wind energy plant is necessary to solve many problems, most important of which is to harmonize the propeller and the generator in terms of maximum energy effect, and stable operation of the system over the entire range of wind speeds. The article suggests nonlinear structural control scheme of synchronous and asynchronous electrical machine with wound rotor, which optimally meet the appropriate energy-momentum characteristics of the generator in the form of a quadratic form.

articleTitle: Characteristics of the hybrid heterogeneous network
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article a hybrid communication network with a heterogeneous on intensity of incoming messages flow and access protocol terrestrial subnetwork is considered. The process of blocking of receiving buffer of local networks stations that make up the terrestrial subnetwork, and satellite communications is considered. It is shown that in analyzing the process of inter-regional transfer of information in a hybrid network, necessary take into account the influence on network characteristics. The model estimates the influence of blocking of the local networks stations receive buffers and communication satellite on the characteristics of the hybrid heterogeneous communication network is carrying out.

articleTitle: At definition the effective bandwidth with a serial key generator circuit
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of the analysis of the frequency dependence of the main energy indicators with a serial key generator circuit, operating without restructuring the oscillating system.

articleTitle: Biotechnical system for stimulation of hematopoesis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Creating a biotechnical system for stimulation of hematopoesis with remote control for scientific research on animals(rats) with the prospect of using on human. In scientific experiments should be conducted blood and urine analysis.

articleTitle: Decision-making in semistructured information systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Currently, public health, there are several methods of decisionmaking, but they are all based on the actions of medical professionals, such as consultation, impact test methods, based on personal experience, etc. The article deals with decision-making process for the semi-knowledge areas such as medical diagnostics and therapeutic effects.

articleTitle: Generalized analysis of reflection parameters meters
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Problems of generalized analysis of MW-range reflection parameters meters are considered.

articleTitle: Research and development of automatic control system of wind power plant
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: When you create a wind energy plant, you must solve many problems, most important of which is to harmonize the propeller and the generator in terms of maximum effect and sustainable energy system in the whole range of wind speeds. articleTitle: Simulation of the electromagnetic mechanism of vibroinsulation system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Methodological suggestions and software tools on vibroinsulation system design are discussed. Vibroinsulation system is created as unified electromagnetic mechanism with embedded control system which is designed based on time-scale separation technique. Simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Decision-making in tasks of a telecommunication network with use of in fuzzy composite rules of a conclusion
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The model of decision-making on the basis of a composite rule of a conclusion is considered, the information in whicha priori and a posteriori is represented fuzzy statementsformalized in the form of membership function.

articleTitle: System models of metrological support and manufacturing control
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Growing manufacture automation, increasing demands as to the quality of management decisions require the refining of industry metrological support. To meet the demand the corresponding mathematical system models of metrological support and manufacturing control are being developed.

articleTitle: Hardware and software complex configuration for automated wildfire detection
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The question under consideration is the system of automated wildfire detection using web cameras. We discuss the existing problems and their solutions, algorithms of video data processing. The architecture of hardware and software complex configuration is offered and principle of its operation is described.

articleTitle: Analysis of current distribution along dipole irradiator with end feed
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: New modification of dipole irradiator, dipole irradiator with end feed, is proposed. By choosing parameters antenna can b e o b tained with required input resistance and 8-like directional diagram. The antenna with low profile and high polarization q uality is a good candidate f or mob ile communication systems with linear, doub le linear or circular polarization.

articleTitle: Detecting of signals of airborne electrical exploration of mineral products in the presence of colored noise
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Processing of data obtained by airborne electrical exploration of mineral products is considered. The data contains desired signal together with colored noise. Bleaching the noise out leads to obtaining white noise with Gaussian distribution. Bleaching allows using less complicated detection algorithms and simplifies detection of anomalies. For further processing two-dimensional data were converted in order to use more simple detection algorithms. We developed detection algorithm taking decision based on Neumann-Pearson criterion. The developed bleaching and detection algorithms take into account peculiarities of data.

articleTitle: Fresnel formulas for electron in heterostructure
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Refraction of a ballistic electronic wave on linear border in heterostructure with two-dimensional electronic gas is considered. The border divides areas with different composition of a solid solution and differing values of effective mass, potential energy and levels of dimensional quantization. The transmission and reflection factors generalizing Fresnels formulas are received.

articleTitle: Laser photoporation of cells
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE 11th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronics Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The opportunity of lifetime formation pores in cells membranes with the help of pulse lasers-photoporation-opens a new biomedical direction of application of lasers. In clause the brief review of ways photoporation of cells membranes with the purpose delivering foreign DNA to cells (trans-fection), executed in conducting laboratories of the world, is given. The own results photoporations of cancer tumorous cells of femtosecond laser radiation with preservation at the irradiated cells of ability to cause growth of a tumor in experimental animals are given.
